thread.title: Apple blocks Google from internal iOS apps over misuse: reports

author: Mike Murphy
title: Apple blocks Google from internal iOS apps over misuse: reports
text:
Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.72% briefly blocked Alphabet's GOOGL, +2.54% GOOG, +2.51% Google from distributing internal iOS apps following reports that a Google app improperly harvested user data, according to multiple reports Thursday. The suspension of its developer certificate was similar to one handed to Facebook Inc. FB, +10.82% on Wednesday after a report that it paid users to install an app that gave Facebook access to virtually all their online data . Facebook's ban only lasted a day though . Google's suspension lasted mere hours; T echCrunch reported Thursday night that its certificate had already been restored.
